text:
Amy H.: @here Quick sync on BrightPlan POC — we need to lock success criteria, model choices (context/toolcall), and security blockers. Can we align today?

Sam R.: Quick summary from presales: target KPI = 95% relevance on evaluation prompts, <200ms median token latency for short queries (interactive flows), and cost target ~ $6k/mo for pilot (est. 5k queries/day). If we can't hit cost, they want a dedicated quote.

Jordan C.: For relevance/evals I'm proposing RAG with embedding retrieval + reranker. Plan: 1) bi-encoder (dense) for retrieval, 2) lightweight cross-encoder for rerank on top-k. We'll run 100 prompts per core intent.

Lee M.: Tooling note — customer requires 3 tool integrations: calendar lookup, internal docs search, and billing API. That means we must support structured tool-calling and JSON outputs (function-calling style). Also large document context for one use-case (long financial reports) — leaning toward 32k context model or chunking+KV cache.

Amy H.: Sample prompt prototype for evals (please iterate):
```
SYSTEM: You are BrightPlan assistant. Keep answers factual and cite doc IDs.
USER: Given this client report (doc_id=FP-2025-03), summarize top 3 risks and return JSON: {"risks": [ {"summary": "", "evidence_doc_ids": [] } ] }
```
We need deterministic structured output to validate automatically.

security-bot: New: BrightPlan sent a security questionnaire. Key asks: KMS integration, per-request audit logs, SOC2 evidence, and encryption-in-transit + at-rest. Uploaded pdf: https://redwood.internal/sec/brightplan_q_2167777.pdf. They also asked about data residency (EU).

Sam R.: Pricing implications: hosted 32k-context models increase token cost; with caching/prefix reuse maybe ~2.5x per-token compared to 8k baseline. I'll put together a hosted vs dedicated estimate. If they commit to 3-6 month reserved capacity we can get a better rate for cross-encoder rerankers.

Jordan C.: Eval plan outline:
- Corpus: 500 real-ish documents (customer-provided), 10 intents, 100 prompts/intent (smoketest + edgecases).
- Metrics: precision@k (retrieval), reranker NDCG, structured output exact-match for required fields, hallucination rate (manual spot-check 5%).
- Models to compare: 16k open quantized model, 32k baseline, and a smaller cheap gen model + cross-encoder.

Lee M.: Ops blocker: BrightPlan wants Private deployment for PHI in docs. Need to confirm if they will accept VPC + customer-managed KMS or require full on-prem. Also need HSM for signing? I'll log a ticket with infra if required.

Amy H.: Security/contract ask: can we answer the questionnaire with the SOC2 timeline? @security-bot please draft a short response and flag anything we can't commit to.

security-bot: Drafting answers now. Flags: on-prem full air-gapped deploy is higher friction and requires sales+eng approval. KMS in VPC: OK. HSM: needs legal & infra review. Will attach redlines by EOD.

Sam R.: For the POC timeline proposal:
- Week 0: sign SOW + access to sample docs
- Week 1: ingest + index + initial embedding tests
- Week 2: reranker evals + toolcall integration prototype
- Week 3: latency/cost tuning + QA
- Week 4: deliverable + acceptance checks
Can we compress? Customer wants a 3-week turn.

Jordan C.: Two immediate technical decisions I need:
1) embeddings dim: 1536 vs 3072? 1536 likely sufficient and cheaper.
2) reranker architecture: linear-time cross-encoder vs distilled cross-encoder. Distilled reduces cost but may lose edge-case precision.

Lee M.: For tool calling we must ensure call-level audit logs and deterministic outputs. Ops prefers structured function-calls JSON schema and will add tracing hooks. Also recommend automatic fallback to non-tool path if auth to an external tool fails.

Amy H.: Actions agreed:
- Amy/Jordan: finalize 100 eval prompts by EOD (first_message_ts 2167777000).
- Lee: confirm embeddings dim + reranker config and check private vs VPC feasibility by tomorrow.
- Sam: update hosted vs dedicated pricing and include reserved-capacity quote.
- security-bot: draft questionnaire responses with redlines.
Meeting: Thursday 10:00am PT to sign off. :thumbsup:

Jordan C.: Small note — add a metric for structured-output exact-match rate; that's our auto-pass/fail gate.

Lee M.: Noted. Also adding a fallback: if >50% of documents exceed chunking threshold, we enable 32k context path.

Sam R.: I'll include pricing scenarios: hosted (pay-as-you-go), hosted with caching, and dedicated reserved 3/6/12mo.

Amy H.: Thanks team. If anyone hits a hard blocker before EOD ping me.

Lee M.: pinging infra for HSM ops: @infra-team please advise on HSM availability and lead times.

Jordan C.: I'll start a small eval run tonight on ~200 prompts so we have early signals.

Amy H.: Great — closing thread for now.
